record.original_question: Suppose a complex reductive algebraic group G acts algebraically on C^n and the categorical quotient C^n//G is two-dimensional. It is known in this situation that C^n//G is isomorphic to C^2/Γ for some finite group Γ acting algebraically on C^2. Which finite groups Γ can occur in this way?

evidence.quote: Using a result of [KR], it was recently proved in [G2] that if a complex reductive algebraic group G acts algebraically on Cn and the categorical quotient Cn//G is two-dimensional, then Cn//G is isomorphic to C2/Γ, where Γ is a finite group acting algebraically on C2.
Problem 3.1. (M. Miyanishi) What are the groups Γ occuring in the above situation?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let G be a complex reductive algebraic group acting algebraically on C^n, and assume that the categorical quotient C^n // G (i.e., Spec of the ring of G-invariant regular functions on C^n) is two-dimensional. It is known that in this situation there exists a finite group Γ acting algebraically (and faithfully) on C^2 such that C^n // G is isomorphic, as an affine algebraic variety, to the quotient C^2 / Γ. Determine precisely which finite groups Γ (up to conjugation in the automorphism group of C^2) can arise in this way.
artifact.category_tag: Algebraic group actions and quotient singularities
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not turn up a definitive classification of the finite groups Γ that occur as quotients C^n//G ≅ C^2/Γ for reductive group actions with two-dimensional categorical quotient. Related results of Kraft-Russell and Gurjar establish the existence of such a Γ, and Miyanishi-type results constrain Γ in particular geometric settings (e.g. small subgroups of GL(2,C) for proper surjections from C^2), but a complete answer to Miyanishi's question does not appear in the located literature.

status_evidence.title: Topology of Open Surfaces around a result of C. P. Ramanujam
status_evidence.snippet: Miyanishi: if V is a normal affine surface with a proper surjective morphism C^2 → V, then V ≅ C^2/G for a small subgroup G of GL(2,C).
status_evidence.claim: Related Miyanishi-type results characterize certain quotients C^2/Γ but do not give a full list for the reductive setting.

status_evidence.title: Homology planes with quotient singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Study of normal affine surfaces with quotient singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Literature on quotient surfaces does not exhibit a complete classification of the Γ in Miyanishi's problem.
